sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: If $\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{18}\right)\sin\left(\frac{5\pi}{18}\right)\sin\left(\frac{7\pi}{18}\right)=K$, then the value of $\sin\left(\frac{10K\pi}{3}\right)$ is :
stem.hi: यदि $\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{18}\right)\sin\left(\frac{5\pi}{18}\right)\sin\left(\frac{7\pi}{18}\right)=K$ है, तो $\sin\left(\frac{10K\pi}{3}\right)$ का मान है :

feynman.en: The angles are $10^\circ$, $50^\circ$ and $70^\circ$, which fit $\sin\theta\sin(60^\circ-\theta)\sin(60^\circ+\theta)=\frac14\sin3\theta$.
feynman.hi: कोण $10^\circ$, $50^\circ$ और $70^\circ$ हैं, जो $\sin\theta\sin(60^\circ-\theta)\sin(60^\circ+\theta)=\frac14\sin3\theta$ में बैठते हैं।

stem.en: Let $S=\{x \in [-\pi,\pi] : \sin x(\sin x+\cos x)=a, a \in \mathbb{Z}\}$. Then $n(S)$ is equal to :
stem.hi: माना $S=\{x \in [-\pi,\pi] : \sin x(\sin x+\cos x)=a, a \in \mathbb{Z}\}$ है। तब $n(S)$ बराबर है :

feynman.en: First find which integers $a$ the left side can reach; its range is narrow, so only $a=0$ and $a=1$ are possible. Then solve each case on $[-\pi,\pi]$ and count.
feynman.hi: पहले देखिए कि बायाँ पक्ष कौन-से पूर्णांक $a$ तक पहुँच सकता है; इसका परिसर छोटा है, अतः केवल $a=0$ और $a=1$ संभव हैं। फिर $[-\pi,\pi]$ पर प्रत्येक स्थिति हल करके गिनिए।

steps.en: $\sin^2x+\sin x\cos x=\frac12+\frac{\sqrt2}{2}\sin\left(2x-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)$, whose range is $\left[\frac{1-\sqrt2}{2},\frac{1+\sqrt2}{2}\right]$; integers in it: $0$ and $1$.
steps.hi: $\sin^2x+\sin x\cos x=\frac12+\frac{\sqrt2}{2}\sin\left(2x-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)$, जिसका परिसर $\left[\frac{1-\sqrt2}{2},\frac{1+\sqrt2}{2}\right]$ है; इसमें पूर्णांक: $0$ और $1$।
